analysis.problem_type: Learn the operator mapping initial pressure parameters to the spatial density field in a shock tube problem.
analysis.description: An SVD-DeepONet model that utilizes Singular Value Decomposition to maintain an orthogonal basis in the trunk network. It is trained using a two-stage procedure and variational Residual-Based Attention (vRBA) to map pressure conditions to density distributions in the LeBlanc shock tube problem.
